test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: The teacher from a South explained the theory in the detailed manner.
A teacher from South explained the theory in the detailed manner.
The teacher from the South explained the theory in a detailed manner.
The teacher from an South explained a theory in a detailed manner.

solution:
The correct answer is **'3'** i.e. **The teacher from the South explained the theory in a detailed manner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The South" **is used with the definite article "**the**" to refer to a specific region.
 
• **"a detailed manner"** correctly uses the indefinite article "**a**" before "detailed manner."

The other options contain the following errors:

 
• Option 1: "from a South" should be "from the South" and "in the detailed manner" should be "in a detailed manner."
 
• Option 2: "A teacher from South" should be "The teacher from the South" and "in the detailed manner" should be "in a detailed manner."
 
• Option 4: "from an South" should be "from the South" and "a theory" should be "the theory."

**Correct sentence:** *The teacher from the South explained the theory in a detailed manner*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to specific regions such as "the South," "the North," "the East," and "the West," it is common to use the definite article "the."
 
• Using the appropriate articles "a" and "the" helps convey accurate meaning in a sentence.
